insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. The space vehicle build will be conducted at TBD contractor location, the cyber-hardening will be conducted at MITLL and T&E conducted at AFRL KAFB SCR. 4.0 Performance Objectives The Government's objective is to achieve the following capabilities and milestones across the period of performance. The contractor shall propose the specific methodology and detailed work breakdown to achieve these objectives: Phase Technical Objectives & Deliverables Base Period (Months 1- 12): System Design, Development, and Initial Hardening Design & Build: Design and construct a space vehicle flat-sat and a corresponding space vehicle cyber range.
